C0772.title: Hybrid SM2/SM3/SM4 Encryption Framework Aligning Instant Messaging with Commercial Cryptography Requirements
C0772.summary: A PLOS One paper proposes a hybrid cryptographic framework for instant messaging systems, applying SM2 for key exchange and authentication, SM4 for message encryption, and SM3 for integrity verification to improve confidentiality, integrity, and availability of communications data. Read together with China's Cryptography Law requirements for legally using commercial cryptography to protect networks and information security, the study is an exploration of national cryptographic algorithms in instant messaging security rather than standalone proof that a system has completed compliance assessment.
